# Vendored sources

`browse/` is the complete tracked source tree of [anomalyco/browse](https://github.com/anomalyco/browse) at commit `3fa986601245d4f2ef9e7260f00d9f4c5a92a3b2` (version 0.0.16), copied without its Git metadata. The upstream [MIT license and copyright notice](browse/LICENSE) remain in place. Upstream dependency and asset licenses require their own review before redistribution. The project is currently preserved as an upstream snapshot, not automatically built or installed with Mini.
